reason: B is the better proposal because it makes a new, falsifiable extension—testing whether dilute Ir can create ordering and raise coercivity—whereas A essentially repeats the Pt/RTA intervention and result already demonstrated in the cited paper. B remains mechanistically risky because ~10 at.% Ir is not clearly sufficient to stabilize directional L1₀-like order, but that uncertainty is directly testable through the composition series and structural characterization.
